column1: # Websites worth keeping a copy of, archived as library titles by a server.
# Columns, separated by single tabs: id, group, address, ZIM name, title (30 characters
# at most), page limit, note. The crawl stays beneath the address given.
#   sudo offline queue site uk          every site in the uk group
#   sudo offline queue site nhs-conditions
# The note on each line says on what terms the site may be copied, and the groups differ.
# Each site in the uk group is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0, which
# permits copying with acknowledgement of the source. The NHS asks that syndicated
# copies be kept current, so archive it again every few months.
# The sites in the cooking group are, with one exception, ordinary copyrighted sites
# whose owners have granted nothing: a copy of one is for your own household's use, to
# be read when the site cannot be reached, and not for publishing or passing on. Leave
# out any whose owner would object, and buy the books of those you come to rely on.
# The archiver fetches two pages at a time and identifies itself, to avoid burdening
# the sites.
# Put your own sites in /etc/offline/sites.local.tsv using the same layout.
